targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM indicator_symbols WHERE active

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM indicator_symbols a CROSS JOIN (VALUES (300),(900),(3600)) p(period_seconds) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT side,reason,probability,candle_epoch,model_version FROM indicator_signals s WHERE s.symbol=a.symbol AND s.period_seconds=p.period_seconds ORDER BY candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true LEFT JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=a.symbol AND m.period_seconds=p.period_seconds AND m.model_version=s.model_version WHERE a.active AND (s.side NOT IN ('CALL','PUT') OR s.side IS NULL OR s.reason <> 'ok' OR s.probability IS NULL OR m.model_version IS NULL OR extract(epoch from now()) >= s.candle_epoch + 2 * p.period_seconds)

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.symbol,i.period_seconds) i.candle_epoch,i.period_seconds FROM indicator_signals i JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=i.symbol AND a.active ORDER BY i.symbol,i.period_seconds,i.candle_epoch DESC) s WHERE extract(epoch from now()) >= candle_epoch + 2 * period_seconds

SELECT a.symbol, a.name AS ativo, CASE p.period_seconds WHEN 300 THEN 'M5' WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' ELSE 'H1' END AS periodo, CASE WHEN s.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND s.reason='ok' AND s.probability IS NOT NULL AND m.model_version IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < s.candle_epoch + 2 * p.period_seconds THEN s.side ELSE 'SEM SINAL' END AS sinal, CASE WHEN s.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND s.reason='ok' AND s.probability IS NOT NULL AND m.model_version IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < s.candle_epoch + 2 * p.period_seconds THEN round((s.probability * 100)::numeric,1) ELSE NULL END AS prob_call_pct, to_timestamp(s.candle_epoch + p.period_seconds) AS vela_fechada, CASE WHEN s.side IS NULL THEN 'sem_dados' WHEN extract(epoch from now()) >= s.candle_epoch + 2 * p.period_seconds THEN 'dados_atrasados' WHEN m.model_version IS NULL AND current_model.model_version IS NOT NULL AND s.model_version IS NOT NULL THEN 'modelo_atualizado_aguardando_fechamento' WHEN m.model_version IS NULL THEN 'modelo_indisponivel' ELSE s.reason END AS estado, CASE WHEN s.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND s.reason='ok' AND s.probability IS NOT NULL AND m.model_version IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < s.candle_epoch + 2 * p.period_seconds THEN s.model_version ELSE NULL END AS modelo FROM indicator_symbols a CROSS JOIN (VALUES (300),(900),(3600)) p(period_seconds) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM indicator_signals x WHERE x.symbol=a.symbol AND x.period_seconds=p.period_seconds ORDER BY candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true LEFT JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=a.symbol AND m.period_seconds=p.period_seconds AND m.model_version=s.model_version LEFT JOIN indicator_model_versions current_model ON current_model.symbol=a.symbol AND current_model.period_seconds=p.period_seconds WHERE a.active ORDER BY a.symbol,p.period_seconds
